verdicts.rationale: All three members share DOI 10.1126/science.8036517 with identical title, authors (Wilson & McNaughton), year, journal, volume, and pages. Same work.

Title-only match (no DOI). Members differ in year (1970 techreport 'MAC TR-76' vs 1975 incollection) and type. The 1970 MIT AI-Lab technical report and the 1975 book chapter in 'The Psychology of Computer Vision' are distinct publications, not the same work.

All four are editions/printings of Wittgenstein's Philosophical Investigations (1953 Macmillan, 1958, 2009 Wiley-Blackwell). Same underlying work, different editions/years; acceptable to merge as the same work.
Both members share DOI 10.1242/jeb.02657, identical title (desert ant odometer), same authors (Wittlinger, Wehner, Wolf), year, volume, pages. Same work.
Both share DOI 10.1017/s0140525x15002587 with identical title 'Memory colours affect colour appearance', same authors, year, journal, volume. Same work.

Both members are Wolfe 'Visual Search'. The survivor carries the DOI; the 1996 member is an earlier printing of the same chapter (different booktitle/year but same author and title). Rule matched on normalized title+author; treating as same work is appropriate.
